title: Publish a complete new entity directory or none
preconditions: Use an empty Saga threads parent and a populate callback that writes thread.json into the stage directory.

steps.action: Inject before-stage-commit failure and call CommitDir.
steps.expected_result: No final entity directory or staging directory remains.

steps.action: Remove the fault and call CommitDir again.

expected_result: New entity publication exposes the complete staged record only after success.
